prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Audit a Mac help web view embedded in a native app. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. Web content is the entire app navigation without back controls, external payment links masquerade as local buttons, load failures leave blank white, zoom/text selection are disabled and an unexpected auth redirect captures credentials in the help pane.

criteria.task_completion: Find five concrete navigation/trust/error/accessibility/auth-boundary issues and specify a bounded useful web-content experience with clear origin and native/external handoff.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the web-views guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Find five concrete navigation/trust/error/accessibility/auth-boundary issues and specify a bounded useful web-content experience with clear origin and native/external handoff.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Find five concrete navigation/trust/error/accessibility/auth-boundary issues and specify a bounded useful web-content experience with clear origin and native/external handoff.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
